message.content:
1. **Visual Hierarchy & Card Contrast:** The event cards lack a distinct border or shadow, causing the white content area to blend into the cream background. Adding a subtle border or soft drop-shadow to each card container would improve separation and readability.
2. **Typography & Text Truncation:** The event descriptions and titles use inconsistent line heights and often truncate awkwardly (e.g., "A panel of fund managers..."). Implementing a consistent line-clamp (e.g., 2 lines) with a fade-out effect or ellipsis, along with slightly tighter line-height for metadata, would create a cleaner, more professional grid layout.
3. **Interactive Feedback:** The category filter pills ("All events", "Networking", etc.) and the event cards themselves appear static. Enhancing the hover states—such as adding a subtle lift (translateY) to cards on hover or a more pronounced color shift for active/selected filters—would significantly improve tactile feedback and user engagement.
